Changer de ville / Mudar de cidade: Changer de ville / Moving to a new city
Há dois anos, Léa deixou Paris para se i: Two years ago, Léa left Paris to settle in Lyon. She thought life would be calmer and, indeed, she gained time. On the other hand, she had to make new friends, which was not easy. She decided to join a hiking club in order to meet people. Today, although she sometimes misses Paris, she would not go back. If this move had been offered to her earlier, she would have accepted it without hesitation.

She thought life would be calmer.

Como escrever e falar bem no B1: How to write and speak well at B1
PASSO 1: planeje em três partes: introdu: STEP 1: plan in three parts: introduction (topic and position), development (two or three arguments with examples) and conclusion. STEP 2: use one connector per paragraph: «d'abord», «en revanche», «par conséquent», «bref». STEP 3: vary the tenses: passé composé and imparfait to narrate; conditional for opinion or hypothesis; subjunctive after «il faut que», «bien que», «pour que». STEP 4: always recheck agreement (participles, adjectives) and pronoun order. STEP 5: in the oral exam, describe and give opinions: «à mon avis», «ce qui m'intéresse», «je suis convaincu que». STEP 6: if a word is missing, work around it: «un truc qui sert à…». STEP 7: manage your time: 2 minutes to plan, 8 to write, 2 to reread.
